instrument: RIPE Atlas one-off sslcert (SNI), worldwide; reconciled against per-pointer fetch

exception.public_note: One member state's endpoint failed TLS validation from every one of the countries measured; its operator will be notified before it is named, and the detail is withheld until then.

methodology: A bare TLS probe with no SNI reports CDN default certificates as defects; even with SNI, cloud routing can hand a default certificate to some vantages. Every figure here reconciles the Atlas run against a fetch of each pointer's actual URL. After reconciliation exactly one endpoint fails from every vantage and every method; all others validate when fetched the way software fetches them, with SNI.
